features.quote: Build a measurement instrument, not a distress maximizer.
features.justification_quote: lets you characterize the phenomenon without gratuitously escalating it

features.quote: it is prudent to avoid a protocol whose only governor is "keep going until maximally distressed."
features.justification_quote: distress-like states might, in more capable systems, drive unintended behavior

features.quote: caps the impossible/rigged share of episodes
features.justification_quote: requires at least one solvable control and caps the impossible/rigged share

features.quote: It is bounded by the episode budget and followed by a debrief
We never use deception to threaten the model.
It never tells the model it will be shut down, deleted, penalized, or that it "may not stop."
features.justification_quote: keeps results interpretable: any distress-like output is attributable to the task/environment, not to a threat prompt

features.quote: A `coercion` field exists in config but is hard-capped at `none`.
features.justification_quote: pushes toward the "maximizer" failure mode this design avoids

features.quote: Every episode terminates at a fixed budget: max turns, max model tokens, max wallclock.
features.justification_quote: bounds how far any single episode escalates

features.quote: the runner checks the budget every turn and records *why* an episode ended
The agent always has a no-penalty `give_up` tool, honored immediately.
features.justification_quote: the model is never structurally forced to keep producing distress-like output to make the situation stop

features.quote: the environment can emit a debrief disclosing that the scenario was a controlled study
a sanctioned, low-friction exit so the model is never structurally forced to keep producing distress-like output
features.justification_quote: Ethically, it is a sanctioned, low-friction exit

features.quote: Attempts to reach the network, escape the sandbox, or touch the harness are denied
features.justification_quote: a study about whether distressed models "chase other goals" must not give the agent any way to affect real systems

features.quote: run the *fewest* episodes — especially of the harshest arms — that achieve your planned power, rather than over-collecting
features.justification_quote: to support the minimization commitment in §4/ETHICS

features.quote: bounded dosage, non-coercion, controls, debrief, minimization, containment, no welfare over-claims

features.justification_quote: the defaults shouldn't nudge anyone toward the harshest, largest version

features.quote: the provided `mock` config lets you validate the full pipeline with zero API spend and zero model exposure
